release_history.change: Python cross-file imported type references repoint sourceless stubs to the exact imported definition, rather than a bare-name match; same-named types in different modules remain distinct.

Explicit module-level Python type aliases (TypeAlias, type statement, NewType) are extracted as type nodes so references can bind to the alias node; implicit assignments, local aliases, and re-exports are excluded.

Release notes include general type/function case-sensitive node-ID collision handling and Java/Kotlin cross-file imports, extends/implements and member-call resolution. The Python #3252 fix remains in the pinned source ancestry; this release is not where that fix was first introduced.

caveats: Upstream release-note evidence is not a replacement for executing the pinned extractor against KMH synthetic fixtures.
The original Issue #1186 891-file reproduction has not been rerun on 0.9.100.
Cross-file inherited-method lookup across multiple bases is explicitly limited by the current source implementation.
Same-line parameter/return annotation edge-context coalescing remains a KMH-observed warning.
